messages:
Nina (Partners): Quick heads-up: planning a partner-facing API envelope change. Move `meta` -> top-level keys and rename auth header `X-Partner-Key` -> `X-Partner-Key-V2`. Target ~6-week runway. Need marketplace resubmission, hardware partner QA, and SI release notes. Who owns partner comms + migration helpers?

Carlos (SDK): Minimal before/after please and does this affect streaming frames?

Nina (Partners): Affects both sync + streaming metadata. Minimal diff: old `{\"meta\":{\"req_id\":\"r-1\"},...}` -> new `{\"req_id\":\"r-1\",\"service_hint\":\"edge\",...}`. Header rename as above.

Rohit (Runtime): I'll build a server-side shim to rewrite v3->v2 and add a per-tenant toggle. PR ETA ~2w. Will emit telemetry when shim used.

Maya (Ops): Canary/runbook: start 0.5% -> 2% over 10 days. Monitor auth failures and P95 latency. Roll back if auth failures >0.5% absolute or P95 increases >50ms. I can own runbook/alerts.

Carlos (SDK): SDK work: auto-detect new envelope, normalize to legacy shape, env var to force v2/v3 for testing. Target client 3.2.0 in ~10 business days. Small Node snippet I will include in migration guide.

MarketplaceBot: Earliest marketplace resubmit slot: 2026-08-04. Include migration guide.

Nina (Partners): I'll collect partner signoffs (Ionix, EdgeWorks, FastIntegrate, AccelSys) and request embargo with Legal. Proposed owners: SDK=Carlos, Runtime=Rohit, Ops=Maya, Outreach=Nina, PR=Priya. Add PRs to the shared tracker by EOD.

Carlos (SDK): Will publish migration README + code examples for Node/Python/Go and add deprecation telemetry.

Rohit (Runtime): Adding console toggle and a 90-day compatibility mode for tenants who need extra runway.

Maya (Ops): I'll post the canary runbook and alert thresholds in this thread when ready.

Nina (Partners): Thanks — kicking off outreach this afternoon. If objections to timeline, flag here today. :thumbsup:
